why: Japanese already left outside a <span class="jp"> on pages as published. check.py reports only characters NOT in here, so a forgotten jp span on a new page shows up while the existing pages stay quiet. Every entry below was looked at once and accepted: most are deck or character names in running prose on the August and September pages, written before the convention settled.
limit: This hides an omission on an existing page when the new name happens to use only characters already listed for that page. It is a noise filter, not a proof.
how_to_update: Add the page and its characters here, in the same commit, only after deciding the unwrapped text is correct. Never regenerate the whole file to make a run clean.
